title: Test keys never in production artifacts
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 12.3 Issuer. QR Code Generation, 12.3 Issuer: “The private key is held in the build environment and never enters this repository”.

statements.label: Test keys never in production artifacts
statements.requirement: Fixed test keys and test PKI (such as the XXA SCA and DSC) SHALL only ship in the testkit module. Production modules SHALL NOT contain or accept them by default.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-ISS-003 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-ISS-003 no private key, and no test key, is in the library's sources` (ArchitectureTest.kt)).
